finding.summary: The `reason` field in label_changes can be empty string when neither 'label_reason' nor 'notes' exists in the case file. The baseline schema requires label_errors_fixed[i].reason to have minLength: 1, so this will cause schema validation to fail.
finding.fix: Provide a default reason when both fields are missing, e.g., `reason = new.get('label_reason') or new.get('notes') or 'label or expected block changed'`

label: false_positive
label_reason: intended: a label fix without evidence must fail the baseline guard (ticket scope 5); baseline.py prints the schema error naming the entry instead of writing the baseline.
notes: finding.line moved 102 -> 87: at raised_sha fee8a9a the `reason or ""` the finding describes is at baseline.py:87 (102 is the harness_error reason in build); the review cited the wrong line.
